required_concepts: a trapezium has only one pair of parallel sides
a parallelogram must have two pairs of parallel sides
acceptable_paraphrases: A trapezium has only one pair of parallel sides.
It’s not because there’s only 1 pair of parallel lines.
Trapezium has only one parallel line.
Because both sides are not equal.
Some trapeziums only have one pair of parallel sides.
Helena’s statement is false because a trapezium only has one pair of parallel sides, while a parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides.
misconceptions: A trapezium can have more than one pair of parallel sides.
Both sides are equal in a trapezium.
A parallelogram can have only one pair of parallel sides.
The name 'trapezium' and 'parallelogram' mean the same thing.
grading_notes: Ensure that the student clearly differentiates between the number of pairs of parallel sides in a trapezium and a parallelogram. Accept minor spelling or grammatical errors as long as the meaning is clear. Misunderstandings about the equality of sides or names will be considered misconceptions.
